definitions.explanation: Describes someone who keeps repeating the same request, action, or question in an annoying or stubborn way. Often has a negative connotation.
Describes food or flavors that are too rich, oily, or heavy, making one feel full or uncomfortable.

examples.japanese: しつこく{質問|しつもん}されて{困|こま}った。
examples.english: I was troubled by persistent questioning.

examples.japanese: しつこい{勧誘|かんゆう}は{迷惑|めいわく}だ。
この{料理|りょうり}はちょっとしつこい。
examples.english: This dish is a bit too heavy/rich.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}を{取|と}るとしつこい{味|あじ}が{苦手|にがて}になる。
examples.english: As you get older, you tend to dislike heavy/rich flavors.

notes:
ADJECTIVE FORMS:
・しつこい (dictionary form)
・しつこく (adverbial form)
・しつこくない (negative)
・しつこかった (past)
・しつこさ (noun form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・しつこい{勧誘|かんゆう} - persistent solicitation
・しつこい{セールス} - pushy sales
・しつこく{質問|しつもん}する - to question persistently
・しつこく{付|つ}きまとう - to persistently follow/stalk

FOOD CONTEXT:
・しつこい{味|あじ} - heavy/rich taste
・{油|あぶら}がしつこい - greasy, oily
・しつこくない/あっさりした - light, refreshing (antonym)

NUANCE: When describing people's behavior, しつこい is typically negative, implying annoyance. However, in some contexts it can suggest tenacity in a neutral way.

SYNONYMS/RELATED:
・{執拗|しつよう} - persistent (more formal)
・くどい - repetitive, long-winded
・あっさり - light (antonym for taste)
